components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill-shaped button for primary actions in the terminal workspace.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #15151f; color: #ff6b9d; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid #2a2a3f; border-radius: 9999px; transition: all 0.3s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ff6b9d; color: #0a0a0f; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,107,157,0.4); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent pill button for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #6b7280; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 9999px; transition: all 0.3s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #e2e8f0; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

components.name: Terminal Card
components.description: CRT monitor container for the terminal workspace.
components.css: .ds-card-terminal { background: #0a0a0f; border: 24px solid #1a1a24; border-radius: 3rem; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); overflow: hidden; position: relative; } .ds-card-terminal::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 1.5rem; box-shadow: inset 0 0 100px rgba(0,0,0,0.95); pointer-events: none; z-index: 70; } .ds-card-terminal-inner { padding: 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: #e2e8f0; }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: Cream card for notebook and gallery workspaces.
components.css: .ds-card-paper { background: #fdfcf8; border-radius: 1rem; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); font-family: 'Funnel Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #3a3a3a; } .ds-card-paper h3 { font-family: 'Funnel Display', 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; }

narrative.overview: bigf.me is a personal workspace rendered as a website: a terminal for engineering, a notebook for thoughts, a gallery for memories. The design system carries two distinct but connected visual registers. The terminal workspace lives in dark synthwave space — CRT glow, neon accents, deep shadows. The notebook and gallery workspaces live in warm analog paper — cream surfaces, ink typography, flat minimalism. Both are authentic to the same person: a builder who thinks in code and reflects on paper.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-register palette: dark terminal vs. warm paper
Structural shadows for depth, flat surfaces for content
Typography as hierarchy: display for drama, mono for technical, sans for reading
Motion as feedback: hover glows, smooth panning, choreographed intro
Nostalgia with intent: every retro effect has a purpose

rules.name: The Register-Switch Rule
rules.body: When moving from terminal to paper workspaces, the palette switches completely. Never mix terminal neon on paper surfaces or paper cream on terminal surfaces. The navigation bar bridges both with a translucent cream treatment.

rules.name: The Neon Rarity Rule
rules.body: The primary pink accent appears on ≤15% of any given dark screen. Its scarcity is the point — when it appears, it signals action.

rules.name: The One Voice Per Surface Rule
rules.body: Terminal workspace uses mono for everything technical. Paper workspace uses sans for everything human. Never mix mono body text with paper backgrounds.

rules.name: The Depth-By-Register Rule
rules.body: Terminal elements may cast deep shadows. Paper elements stay flat or use minimal diffuse shadows. The elevation system itself signals which workspace you're in.

dos: Do use the full dual-register palette: terminal for engineering, paper for reflection.
Do keep neon accents rare — ≤15% of any dark surface.
Do use structural shadows in the terminal and flat/minimal shadows in paper.
Do maintain the 3rem rounded corners for main canvas items — this is a signature shape.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for all CRT effects and animations.
Do use Funnel Display for dramatic moments (intro, headlines) and Funnel Sans for reading.
Do keep line lengths at 65–75ch for body text.
donts: Don't mix terminal neon colors on paper backgrounds.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default — blur only when it serves depth, not decoration.
Don't create identical card grids with icon + heading + text repeated endlessly.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) — use solid color emphasis via weight or size.
Don't use side-stripe borders greater than 1px as colored accents.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number, small label, gradient accent).
Don't suppress the custom cursor on non-interactive elements — it is part of the brand.
Don't use em dashes — use commas, colons, or periods.
